ASSIST_RESPONSE_INVALID.message: The model answered, but its answer could not be used.
ASSIST_RESPONSE_INVALID.hint: Run it again. If it keeps happening, try another model in AI providers.

ASSIST_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Add and enable an AI provider in AI providers.

ASSIST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.message: This month’s AI budget has been reached.
ASSIST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.hint: Raise the budget in the agent’s settings or wait for next month.

ASSIST_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND.message: This reference document no longer exists.

SITE_BRIEF_GENERATION_FAILED.message: The document could not be turned into a site plan.
SITE_BRIEF_GENERATION_FAILED.hint: Check that the document really describes a website and that the AI provider answers (the “Test” button in AI providers), then try again.

SITE_BRIEF_RESPONSE_INVALID.message: The model did not return a usable analysis of the document.
SITE_BRIEF_RESPONSE_INVALID.hint: Try again, or pick a more capable model in AI providers.

SITE_PLAN_NO_PROVIDER.message: No active AI provider: the document cannot be analysed.
SITE_PLAN_NO_PROVIDER.hint: Enable a provider in AI providers.

SITE_PLAN_DECISION_MISSING.message: Some items have no decision yet.
SITE_PLAN_DECISION_MISSING.hint: Keep or drop every item before applying the plan.

SITE_PLAN_DECISION_UNKNOWN_ITEM.message: Your choice matches nothing in this plan.
SITE_PLAN_DECISION_UNKNOWN_ITEM.hint: Reopen the proposal and start again.

SITE_PLAN_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATED.message: The plan contradicts a constraint in the document.

DOCUMENT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.message: This file format is not supported.
DOCUMENT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Use a PDF, a DOCX, a Markdown file or plain text.

DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE.hint: Split it or make it smaller.

DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.message: The text of this document could not be read.
DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.hint: Check that the file is not damaged, or export it in another format.

DOCUMENT_NO_TEXT_LAYER.message: This document has no readable text (it is probably a scan).
DOCUMENT_NO_TEXT_LAYER.hint: Export it as a text PDF, or paste its content into a Markdown file.

AGENT_NO_PROVIDER.message: No active AI provider: this agent cannot answer.
AGENT_NO_PROVIDER.hint: Enable a provider in AI providers.

AGENT_UNKNOWN.message: This agent does not exist (any more).

AGENT_DUPLICATE.message: An agent already has this name.

AGENT_DEFINITION_INVALID.message: This agent’s settings are not valid.
AGENT_DEFINITION_INVALID.hint: Check the name, the budget (zero or more) and the tools.

AGENT_BUILTIN_UNDELETABLE.message: An agent shipped with Cogenta cannot be deleted.
AGENT_BUILTIN_UNDELETABLE.hint: Disable it if you do not want to use it.

AGENT_LOOP_RECURSION_LIMIT.message: The agent went round in circles and stopped.

AGENT_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.message: Agents are not available on this site.
AGENT_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Restart the site or check Operations.

AGENT_SKILL_UNKNOWN.message: This skill does not exist (any more).

AGENT_SKILL_DUPLICATE.message: A skill already has this name.

AGENT_SKILL_BUILTIN_UNDELETABLE.message: A skill shipped with Cogenta cannot be deleted.
AGENT_SKILL_BUILTIN_UNDELETABLE.hint: You can edit it or remove it from the default skills.

SKILL_DEFINITION_INVALID.hint: It must start with a header holding “name” and “description”.

AGENT_SKILL_RESOURCE_INVALID.message: This file cannot be attached to the skill.

PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.hint: Add its key in AI providers.

PROVIDER_ID_INVALID.message: This provider identifier is not valid.
PROVIDER_ID_INVALID.hint: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, no spaces (“auto” is reserved).

PROVIDER_CUSTOM_BASE_URL_REQUIRED.message: A custom provider needs an address.
PROVIDER_CUSTOM_BASE_URL_REQUIRED.hint: Enter the address of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

PROVIDER_KEY_REQUIRED.message: Changing a provider’s address means entering its API key again.
PROVIDER_KEY_REQUIRED.hint: The saved key is never sent on its own to another address.

PROVIDER_TUNING_INVALID.message: One of the tuning values is outside the allowed range.
PROVIDER_TUNING_INVALID.hint: Use a reasonable positive whole number or leave the field empty.

PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED.message: The AI provider refused the request.
PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED.hint: Check the key and the model with the “Test” button in AI providers.

PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.message: The AI provider is limiting the number of requests.
PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.hint: Wait a moment before trying again.

PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.message: The AI provider took too long to answer.
PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.hint: Try again, or raise the maximum wait in AI providers.

PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID.message: The AI provider returned an answer that makes no sense.
PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID.hint: Try again, or check the provider’s address.

TOOL_CALL_REJECTED.message: This action is not allowed for this agent.
TOOL_CALL_REJECTED.hint: Adjust its permissions in its settings.

TOOL_INPUT_INVALID.message: The agent asked for a tool with invalid parameters.
TOOL_INPUT_INVALID.hint: Try again; the agent usually corrects itself.

THEME_NO_PROVIDER.message: No active AI provider: the theme cannot be generated.
THEME_NO_PROVIDER.hint: Enable a provider in AI providers.

PROMPT_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN.message: This prompt template does not exist (any more).

PROMPT_TEMPLATE_DUPLICATE.message: A prompt template already has this name.

PROMPT_TEMPLATE_BUILTIN_UNDELETABLE.message: A template shipped with Cogenta cannot be deleted.

PROMPT_TEMPLATE_INVALID.message: This prompt template is not valid.
PROMPT_TEMPLATE_INVALID.hint: Check its name, category and text.

PROMPT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER_UNRESOLVED.message: This template uses an unknown variable.
PROMPT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER_UNRESOLVED.hint: Only use the variables listed under the field.

CHANNEL_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.hint: Set its credentials on the server, then try again.

CHANNEL_LINK_CODE_INVALID.message: This link code is no longer valid.

CONTENT_READ_ONLY.message: This change is disabled on a production site.
CONTENT_READ_ONLY.hint: Make it from development mode (“cogenta dev”).

AUTH_FORBIDDEN.message: Your role does not allow this action.

INTERNAL.hint: Try again; if it persists, check Operations.

aiPlanNotes.removedPage: The document rules out “{{topic}}” (“{{quote}}”). The page “{{name}}” was removed from the plan.

warm-editorial.label: Warm editorial
warm-editorial.description: A generous type scale, a paper background, one restrained accent, comfortable density.

clean-and-clinical.label: Clean and clinical
clean-and-clinical.description: A near-neutral palette, a tight scale, compact density, a cool accent, sharp corners.

bold-and-graphic.label: Bold and graphic
bold-and-graphic.description: A strongly saturated accent, big jumps in size, generous radius, high contrast.

quiet-and-minimal.label: Quiet and minimal
quiet-and-minimal.description: Near-monochrome, wide spacing, a small scale, almost no rounding.

classic-and-formal.label: Classic and formal
classic-and-formal.description: Deep neutral tones, a conservative scale, serif headings, an understated accent.

followUp.demoDrafts_one: {{count}} demonstration entry is waiting as a draft. Read it before publishing.
followUp.demoDrafts_other: {{count}} demonstration entries are waiting as drafts. Read them before publishing.

followUp.pageDrafts_other: {{count}} pages are waiting as drafts: they have a title and a purpose, not their content yet.
followUp.paletteLive: The new palette is already live, no restart needed.
followUp.restartForDesign: Restart the site to show the new design.

skipped.taxonomyExists: the site already has a taxonomy with that name: replacing an existing one is a migration, not a simple edit
